194A.notes: Primary: full-year tanshin of 13 Aug 2026 (summary page and PDF) and nine-month tanshin of 13 May 2026, both on www2.jpx.co.jp. FY June 2026: basic EPS 124.88 vs 79.34 (+57.4%); profit attributable 939,402k vs 593m (+58.4%). Nine months: EPS 79.58 vs 40.28; profit 597,775k vs 301,086k. Quarter is my subtraction: 124.88-79.58 = 45.30 vs 79.34-40.28 = 39.06 (+16.0%); quarterly EPS by subtraction ignores share-count changes (Matsui Securities shows Q4 EPS 45.48 vs 39.07, same result). Guidance: profit 1,005,368k (+7.0%), EPS 132.90; 132.90/124.88 = +6.42%. The company gives no adjusted growth figure, so `adjusted` is null. But FY2026 profit includes extraordinary gains of 251,315k (negative goodwill 227,452k) against extraordinary losses of 86,140k: the +57.4% and the Q4 +16.0% are flattered by them (Q4 alone holds 72,998k of the negative goodwill gain and the 83,376k impairment, both by subtraction from the nine-month figures). Ordinary profit rose 24.6% in the year; the forecast has operating profit +39.3% but net profit only +7.0% (the tanshin does not explain the gap; the absence of the one-off gain is the likely reason, my inference). Dividend: nothing paid for FY2026 or earlier; 26 yen is the company's FORECAST for FY June 2027 (payout 19.6%), not a declared dividend. NOT READ: the Q1 FY2027 tanshin (July-September 2026) was filed on 11 Nov 2026 15:30 (IRBANK listing, doc id 140120261111573837); the PDF could not be opened (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/194A0/140120261111573837.pdf and https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20261111/140120261111573837.pdf: permission request not answered; kabutan.jp article k202611110220 failed). Only a Kabutan headline seen in search results says Q1 ordinary profit rose 16%; no figures were read, so ytd/quarter here are still the June 2026 year. The main session should re-read Q1 and update ytd/quarter and check whether the forecast was changed. No lost customer or exited business found; nothing indicating a lasting deterioration, so `departed` and `permanent` are null.
